The 16th Annual Scientific Conference Faculty of Veterinary Medicine Suez Canal University (Artificial Intelligence in Veterinary Medicine: Current Status and Future Prospects)
22-25 Oct 2024 Ismailia and port said, Egypt The 16th Scientific Conference of the Faculty of Veterinary Medicine at Suez Canal University, organized by the postgraduate sector, is one of the leading academic events to be held in Port Said. The Faculty invites all researchers to submit innovative studies across all veterinary disciplines, particularly those exploring the role of Artificial Intelligence in enhancing animal production and ensuring high-quality, safe food for humans. This initiative aligns with Egypt’s vision for a dignified life for its citizens and aims to foster collaboration among Egyptian and international universities, research institutions, and industry stakeholders, in pursuit of the Faculty’s mission and strategic goals.
